components.text: When a canvas changes, affected glyphs enter a revalidation queue. If a bound glyph is damaged, the array end effect runs first; after reverse indexes are cleaned, surviving glyphs

pages.text: can be organized by a new boundary.

$(f:minecraft:uniform)canvas edit
  -> affected blocks
  -> glyph revalidation
  -> array register / teardown
  -> canvas + glyph sync$(/f)

• GlyphChunkStorage keeps glyph relations across chunks.
• The client renders synchronized glyph overlays; the server state is authoritative.
